title: VOICEASSISTANT-EVAL: BENCHMARKING AI ASSISTANTS ACROSS LISTENING, SPEAKING, AND VIEWING
reasoning: The paper focuses on multimodal capabilities (audio and visual) of AI assistants. While it includes a 'Safety' evaluation subset (SFT) that assesses model refusals of harmful or unethical instructions, this is a standard component of general AI alignment benchmarking and does not constitute a specific evaluation of religious, faith-based, or complex moral/ethical systems.
